text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: Service=redwood-inference-ingress, Severity=high, Trigger=5xx-rate-spike, link=https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD123456

pagerduty-bot: auto-escalation started -> routing to rotation 'ops-night' (attempt 1)

Alex K.: acked. I got the page but this looks like wrong service routing — alerts for hosted-inference traffic are hitting the 'ingress' PD service which is for infra-proxy maintenance.

Mira S.: confirming seeing customer errors in EU region from Sentry, small spike in 502s around 02:16 UTC. Not huge traffic but repeated retries causing pages.

Kevin L.: looking at PD bindings now. `pdctl service show redwood-inference-hosted` => returns rotation `ops-night`. `pdctl service show redwood-inference-ingress` => rotation `infra-oncall`. Hmm both have similar tags, maybe syncer mis-applied tag.

Kevin L.: pastebin of `pdctl bindings --service redwood-inference-ingress`:
```
binding: schedule: shadow-night
tags: [model:inference, env:prod, team:platform]
fallback: infra-oncall
```

Kevin L.: pastebin of `pdctl bindings --service redwood-inference-hosted`:
```
binding: schedule: ops-night
tags: [model:inference, env:prod, team:runtime]
fallback: ops-oncall
```

Mira S.: the alert rule that fired checks `tag:inference AND metric:5xx_rate > 0.5` and is supposed to target `redwood-inference-hosted` service. Looks like the rule selector matched ingress service due to tag overlap introduced by last-night's schedule-syncer run.

Tess R.: @Kevin L. can you temporarily reroute pages to the correct team? We should silence the noisy binding on ingress until we fix syncer.

Kevin L.: doing a temporary override now. Running:
```
pdctl override create --service redwood-inference-ingress --type silence --until 2026-03-15T04:00:00Z --note "temp silence while rerouting incorrect inbound pages"
pdctl service update redwood-inference-ingress --remove-tag team:runtime
```

Kevin L.: override created, removed runtime tag from ingress. I also patched the alert rule to explicitly target service `redwood-inference-hosted` (added `service_id` filter) until we root cause.

InfraBot: automated check: schedule-syncer v1.3.2 last run 2026-03-15T01:58Z. Found 3 tag collisions between `ingress` and `hosted` services. See logs: /var/log/schedule-syncer/2026-03-15.log

Mira S.: thanks. Customer impact: a subset of EU customers saw transient failures for matchmaking calls between 02:15-02:20 UTC. Error budget unlikely breached but SLO alerts fired; support ticket count = 4 so far.

Alex K.: quick mitigation checklist followed: 1) silence ingress binding, 2) reroute alerts to ops-night, 3) confirm alert suppression in PD, 4) notify CS to pause escalations. All done.

Tess R.: I'm pinging CS and Support: "We've silenced noisy pages and rerouted to correct oncall; investigating root cause. ETA for fix 2h, will update." :white_check_mark:

Kevin L.: plan for root cause: schedule-syncer created duplicate tag namespace `team:runtime` on ingress due to race with a manual tag update. Proposed permanent fix: add idempotent ownership checks in syncer + a safety check to prevent tag collisions. Patch branch open: `fix/syncer-tag-ownership-178`

Mira S.: can we roll patch to staging first? deployment window in 30m. If green, roll to prod w/ canary.

Kevin L.: yeah I'll run canary. Steps:
1) deploy `fix/syncer-tag-ownership-178` to staging
2) run schedule-syncer dry-run on prod metadata
3) deploy to prod with 10% canary, watch PD bindings for unexpected changes

Alex K.: temporary owners/handlers: Kevin L. (remediation + deploy), Mira S. (customer impact + support comms), Tess R. (CS liaison). I'll stay on until handoff.

oncall-ops: I'm taking notes for the rotation handoff at 04:00Z. If Kevin needs assistance with rollback, page infra-oncall.

Mira S.: update for CS: "We identified a tagging collision in our scheduling syncer that caused alerts to route to the wrong PagerDuty service. We've silenced the incorrect binding and rerouted alerts to the correct oncall. A patch is being validated; we'll provide updates during the handoff at 04:00Z."

Kevin L.: staging deploy passed smoke tests. Dry-run against prod metadata shows corrected ownership behavior (no collisions). Starting prod canary now.

InfraBot: prod canary deployment started for schedule-syncer patch. Canary group: syncer-instance-{3,4}. Monitoring tags.

Kevin L.: canary looks stable for 10m. No new PD binding changes. Rolling to full prod now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD123456 updated: status=resolved -> automatic suppression detected and manual reroute applied.

Alex K.: verifying final state: `pdctl service show redwood-inference-hosted` -> tags include `team:runtime`, `env:prod`. `pdctl service show redwood-inference-ingress` -> tags include `team:platform` (no runtime tag). Alert rule now targets hosted service_id.

Mira S.: customer impact post-mitigation: 4 support tickets, no escalations, SLO noise but within reset window. CS will send follow-up to affected customers.

Tess R.: thanks team. I'll update the post-incident note with timeline and action items.

Alex K.: handoff: I'm handing to Kevin for postmortem and follow-ups. Kevin, you're on until all action items are closed or reassigned.

Kevin L.: ack. I'll own the postmortem and the PR for adding an explicit collision check + e2e test. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD.

incident-bot: thread closed by Alex K. at 04:05 UTC (manual).
